context: A uni student interviews a teacher about language exchange events
purpose: Teach: ディスカッション/ネイティブ/コミュニティー/劇団/騎士/奮闘/ハッキリ/ブルース

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、大学の言語交換イベントについて取材させてください。最近、参加者が増えてるって聞きました。
lines.en: Sensei, please let me interview you about the university's language exchange events. I heard participation has been growing recently.
lines.style: Polite, slightly nervous student opening an interview respectfully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん。うちのイベントはネイティブの留学生と日本人学生が自由に話せる場で、地域コミュニティーとも繋がってるのが特徴ですよ。
lines.en: Of course. Our events are spaces where native exchange students and Japanese students can speak freely, and a key feature is the link with the local community.
lines.style: Warm professional teacher explaining program with measured pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。具体的にはどんな活動があるんですか?グループディスカッションとか?
lines.en: I see. Specifically what kinds of activities are there? Things like group discussions?
lines.style: Curious follow-up question, leaning forward with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、ディスカッション形式が中心ですけど、学生主催の劇団も立ち上げて、英語と日本語で短い劇を上演してるんです。去年は『黒の騎士』っていう創作劇が好評でした。
lines.en: Yes, discussion-style sessions are the core, but students also launched a theater troupe and perform short plays in English and Japanese. Last year a creation called 'Black Knight' was well received.
lines.style: Animated teacher sharing favorite program highlights enthusiastically.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 劇団まであるんですか!すごいですね。騎士役とか、演じる学生も奮闘したんでしょうね。
lines.en: You even have a theater troupe! That's amazing. The students playing the knight role must have really struggled and worked hard.
lines.style: Impressed reaction with empathetic comment about student effort.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうなんですよ。日々奮闘してました。あと、音楽好きな子たちはブルースのセッションもやってて、言語の壁を越えて盛り上がってます。
lines.en: Indeed. They worked hard day after day. Also, the music-loving students hold blues sessions, and they get really lively, crossing the language barrier.
lines.style: Fond reminiscing tone, painting a vivid picture of campus life.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 音楽まで!参加するメリットをハッキリ言うと、何でしょうか?記事の読者に伝えたくて。
lines.en: Even music! If you had to state the benefits of joining clearly, what would they be? I want to convey it to the article's readers.
lines.style: Journalist-mode question seeking a quotable, concise answer.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ハッキリ言えば、自然な会話力と、一生もんの友達ができる事。教室では絶対に得られない経験ですよ。
lines.en: To put it plainly, you gain natural conversational ability and lifelong friends. It's an experience you absolutely cannot get in a classroom.
lines.style: Confident, definitive closing statement from an experienced educator.
